premise: Fox's big bouncy steps keep waking everyone at nap time; Deer shows him how to lift each hoof slowly, Mouse shows him whisper-paws, and Fox tiptoes so well he surprises himself.
inspiration: Folk pattern of the loud one taught by the quiet ones (The Elephant and the Mouse motif), turned: Fox is not scolded but shown, and gets to be proud of quiet.
lesson: Being quiet is a skill, and it can be fun.

en-US.title: Fox Learns to Tiptoe
en-US.text: {flower:sway loop 0.3} It was nap time in the forest. Shh. Everybody was dozing except Fox. Fox came {fox:hop x3} bounding down the path. Thump! Thump! Thump! Flowers {flower:wobble x2} jiggled. Mouse {mouse:hop} popped up from his leaf. Fox, said Mouse. Oh! said Fox. Sorry! Deer opened one eye. {deer:pulse} Watch, said Deer. He lifted one hoof, slow as honey, and set it down. Not a sound. Fox lifted one paw, slow as honey, and set it down. {fox:wobble 0.3} Thump. Hmm. Mouse crept over. Whisper-paws, said Mouse. Like this. He spread his toes and tip-tip-tipped across a leaf. Fox spread his toes. He lifted his tail. He held his breath. Tip. {fox:pulse 0.3} Tip. Tip. Nothing. Not even a rustle. Fox looked back at his own quiet paws. {fox:sparkle} Well, he whispered. Look at me. And he tiptoed all the way home, just to feel it again.

es-ES.title: Zorro aprende a andar de puntillas
es-ES.text: {flower:sway loop 0.3} Era la hora de la siesta en el bosque. Chist. Todos dormitaban. Todos menos Zorro. Zorro llegó {fox:hop x3} a brincos por el camino. ¡Pum! ¡Pum! ¡Pum! Las flores {flower:wobble x2} temblaron. Ratón {mouse:hop} asomó de su hoja. Zorro, dijo Ratón. ¡Uy!, dijo Zorro. ¡Perdón! Intentó andar suave. Pum, pum. Ciervo abrió un ojo. {deer:pulse} Mira, dijo Ciervo. Levantó una pezuña, lento como la miel, y la posó. Ni un ruido. Zorro levantó una pata, lento como la miel, y la posó. {fox:wobble 0.3} Pum. Mmm. Ratón se acercó. Patitas de susurro, dijo Ratón. Así. Abrió los deditos y tip-tip-tip cruzó una hoja. Zorro abrió los dedos. Levantó la cola. Aguantó la respiración. Tip. {fox:pulse 0.3} Tip. Tip. Nada. Ni un crujido. Zorro miró sus propias patas silenciosas. {fox:sparkle} Vaya, susurró. Mírame. Y se fue de puntillas hasta su casa, solo por sentirlo otra vez.
